name: light-rays
title: Light Rays
description: Soft blurred light shafts shine down from above, swinging slightly and fading in and out over two ambient glows: an atmosphere layer for titles and reveals.

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.lightRays(q(".mw-light-rays"), tl, 0, { count: 9, color: "rgba(160, 210, 255, 0.45)", speed: 6, preroll: 6, hold: 8 });

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: Rays start dark until their delay, as upstream; `preroll` (s) starts the clock earlier so the first frame is already lit. length 70vh becomes px of the frame (70 % of its height).
moworks.titleVi: Tia sáng mềm rọi xuống từ trên
